description: Remote app dock and control surface for a Windows PC, driven from a phone over Wi-Fi or USB
notes: Upstream only ships an Inno Setup installer; scoop extracts the program files automatically (innosetup mode) without running the installer, writing the registry or needing UAC. Shortcuts are created by scoop.

Config and pairing data live in %APPDATA%\windock (outside the app directory), so no persist is needed. The installer's optional HKCU autostart entry is not created; add WinDockTray.exe to Startup manually if wanted.
